signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a single-story house frontage, partially obscured by mature trees but with the front yard, house facade, and neighboring structures visible.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds with a stone-edged garden and a small fenced planting area exist, but they look homeowner-maintained rather than showing crew-level work.

signals.notes: Pale yellow ranch-style house set behind a well-kept lawn with mulched tree rings and a stone-bordered garden bed; heavy tree cover hides much of the roof and facade.
